summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with unaudited operational and production metrics for August 2026. The release details monthly Bitcoin production of 174 BTC (up 55.4% month-over-month), total hashrate under management of 20.6 EH/s (up 45.1%), fleet efficiency of 16.7 J/TH, and power capacity of 344 MW. It also reports Bitcoin holdings of 1,373 BTC (44 BTC pledged), split between self-mining and cloud mining results. This is a routine operational update, containing no transaction, corporate action, or special-situation event.
